title_ja: 公開調達実績と仕様書の対応表
title_en: Public procurement costs and specification register
caveat_ja: 契約額の公表と、仕様書・価格内訳の公開は別です。別契約の重複・共用関係、構成との対応、保守期間を確認するまで合算や部品単価への換算を行いません。単一のAIモデルによる確認であり、独立したAIモデルの合意判定は未完了です。
caveat_en: A published contract amount does not imply public specifications or component prices. Do not aggregate contracts or derive component prices before checking overlap, shared facilities, configuration matching, and maintenance terms. These single-model checks have not passed Consensus review by independent models.

cases.scope_en: Total package contract. Matching to the public configuration, component prices, and included installation and maintenance are unconfirmed.

cases.scope_en: Power expansion for compute and cooling, with connections to or shared infrastructure with Fugaku and quantum HPC. Tax rate, allocation, and overlap with other contracts are unconfirmed.

cases.scope_en: The announcement covers installation, lease, and maintenance/operation support. Specifications require confidentiality commitments, so OpenFS records only the public announcement. Award value was not researched in this update.

cases.title_ja: 名古屋大学「不老」NEXTシステムの借入
cases.buyer: Tokai National Higher Education and Research System / Nagoya University

configuration_observation.summary_ja: 公表構成はCPU 256ノードとGPU 54ノード（各4基のB200）。2026年10月1日の運用開始予定で、現在の構成ページは共有ストレージの実効容量を37.44 PBと記載しています。
configuration_observation.summary_en: The planned configuration has 256 CPU nodes and 54 GPU nodes with four B200 GPUs each. Service is planned for 2026-10-01; the current system page lists 37.44 PB of effective shared storage.
configuration_observation.match_caveat_ja: 公告と落札公示は件名・機関・公告日で対応しますが、最終仕様書と契約範囲は未照合です。1月の発表資料のストレージ容量と現在の構成ページに差があり、容量の定義・構成変更を確認する必要があります。
configuration_observation.match_caveat_en: Tender and award match by buyer, title, and cited tender date, but final specifications and contract scope remain unmatched. Storage capacity differs between the January announcement and the current system page; capacity definitions and configuration changes need checking.

cases.scope_ja: 落札価格の公表値です。公告上の借入期間は78か月で、入札額に10%を加えた額を落札価格とします。公示は月額・期間総額を明記していないため、支払単位は未確認のまま保持します。保守・設置作業・施設費の内包範囲も未確認です。
cases.scope_en: Published award amount. The tender specifies 78 months and adds 10% tax to the bid. The award does not explicitly label its amount as monthly or period-total, so payment basis remains unknown. Maintenance, installation, and facility inclusions are also unconfirmed.

cases.title_ja: 筑波大学ユニファイドメモリ型スーパーコンピュータの借入
cases.title_en: University of Tsukuba unified-memory supercomputer lease

configuration_observation.summary_ja: 同大学のSiriusは24ノード、各ノードにMI300Aを4基搭載し、2026年3月27日に稼働開始したと公表されています。技術概要には5.2 PBのEXAScalerも記載されています。
configuration_observation.summary_en: The university reports that Sirius began service on 2026-03-27 with 24 nodes and four MI300A APUs per node. Its technical overview also lists a 5.2 PB EXAScaler filesystem.
configuration_observation.match_caveat_ja: 公開されたSirius構成は対応候補です。2025年3月11日の公告と落札公示は対応しますが、契約がこの構成のどこまでを含むかは未確認です。借入開始日と稼働開始日は別の事象です。
configuration_observation.match_caveat_en: Sirius is a candidate configuration match. The award explicitly cites the 2025-03-11 tender, but its coverage of the public configuration is unconfirmed. Lease start and operational start are different events.

cases.scope_ja: 月額1,188万円（税込）。公告の72か月を同額で支払うと仮定した期間合計は単純計算であり、機器の購入価格や5年間TCOではありません。契約変更、保守範囲、電力費等は未確認です。2024年の同名公告とは区別しています。
cases.scope_en: The award is JPY 11.88 million per month including tax. Multiplication over the tender's 72 months assumes an unchanged rate; it is neither equipment purchase price nor five-year TCO. Amendments, maintenance scope, and energy costs remain unverified. The similarly named 2024 tender is a separate record.

cases.scope_ja: 2025年度の保守一式の契約額で、計算機購入費ではありません。保守対象、交換部材、ソフトウェア支援、税区分、他の運用費との境界は未確認のため、別システムの保守率に転用しません。
cases.scope_en: This is the FY2025 maintenance package, not computer acquisition. Covered equipment, replacement parts, software support, taxes, and boundaries with other operating costs are unconfirmed; it is not used as a maintenance-rate estimate for another system.

coverage_gaps.description_ja: 計算機一式の契約と実導入構成の対応が未確認です。
coverage_gaps.description_en: The package contract has not been matched to the deployed configuration.
coverage_gaps.next_action_ja: 公開可能な最終仕様書、契約範囲、構成資料を照合します。
coverage_gaps.next_action_en: Match publicly usable final specifications, contract scope, and configuration records.

coverage_gaps.description_ja: 機器別の価格根拠と、費用モデルの独立検証案件が不足しています。
coverage_gaps.description_en: Component-price evidence and independent validation procurements are missing.
coverage_gaps.next_action_ja: CPU/GPUノード、ネットワーク、ストレージの内訳公開案件を追加し、校正用と検証用を分離します。
coverage_gaps.next_action_en: Add itemized CPU/GPU, network, and storage procurements; separate calibration from validation cases.

coverage_gaps.description_ja: 別契約の共用・重複、税率、施設条件、運用保守費が未確認です。
coverage_gaps.description_en: Shared scope, overlap, tax rates, facility constraints, and recurring costs are unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.next_action_ja: 契約別の包含・除外表を作り、二重計上を防いで5年間TCOを算出します。
coverage_gaps.next_action_en: Build an inclusion/exclusion matrix per contract before computing a five-year TCO without double counting.

coverage_gaps.description_ja: JSS4の仕様書は公開利用可能な形で取得していません。
coverage_gaps.description_en: JSS4 specifications have not been obtained in a publicly usable form.
coverage_gaps.next_action_ja: 秘密保持対象を取得せず、公開される落札結果とシステム概要を追跡します。
coverage_gaps.next_action_en: Track public award results and system descriptions without obtaining confidential specifications.

coverage_gaps.description_ja: 不老NEXTの支払単位と、不老・弐の資料間で異なるストレージ容量の対応が未確認です。
coverage_gaps.description_en: Furo NEXT payment basis and differing Furo-ni storage capacities remain unresolved.
coverage_gaps.next_action_ja: 公開契約資料と改訂仕様を追跡し、月額／期間総額、物理／実効容量、構成変更を区別します。
coverage_gaps.next_action_en: Track public contract records and revised specifications to separate monthly/period totals, physical/effective capacity, and configuration changes.
